items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: the bass player, Ted Sturgis with Roy Eldridge, he made " Plucking the Base.

ctx.x: Yeah, I do remember that. Well,

the bass player, Ted Sturgis with Roy Eldridge, he made " Plucking the Base. Yeah. Because we used to play that at the Arcadia, and it used to go over very big. And then, you know, I did all of those things with Lucky Millinder.
Remember some of the things you did with Lucky?
